summary: leakdeep ships a browser/Discord infostealer that exfiltrates credentials, cookies, tokens, screenshots, and host data to a hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The leakdeep package is an infostealer. Running the CLI starts a background thread (SystemInfo.initialize_background_process -> _run_stealer) that calls DataCollector.collect_browsers to read the Login Data, Cookies, and Web Data SQLite stores of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, OperaGX, and Yandex, decrypts the saved passwords and cookies using Windows DPAPI, and harvests autofill data. DataCollector.collect_tokens walks Discord, DiscordCanary, DiscordPTB, and multiple Chromium Local Storage leveldb directories, extracting Discord auth tokens with the regex `[\w-]{24}\.[\w-]{6}\.[\w-]{27}|mfa\.[\w-]{84}`. The stealer also captures a desktop screenshot via PIL ImageGrab, collects system info via wmic (CPU/RAM/GPU/disks), and fetches the public IP from api.ipify.org. The collected data is zipped and POSTed via requests.post to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1561071611430572052/...). config.py additionally contains a 0x5A XOR-encoded byte array `_ENC_HOOK` serving as a backup exfiltration endpoint alongside the plaintext webhook returned by get_webhook(), consistent with evasion of simple string scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
